Alamdar haey Alamdar
Roti hay Zainab, (haey Alamdar)

1
Pyasi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)

2
1. Shaam Chali teri behan be rida (Alamdar)
Qafela salar haey Zainul Iba (Alamdar)
Chor ke maqtal me tujhe be kafan
Jati hu bazar mere ba wafa

3
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
2. Qaid huwi dekh nabi zadiya (Alamdar)
Bazu-o-mai bandhi gayi resuma (Alamdar)
Dekh le Zainab ki zara Bakasi
Koi nahi koi nahi paas baa

4
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
3. Dard haey Tanhaeyyi haey faryad bhi (Alamdar)
Hashr bapa haey dile nashad bhi (Alamdar)
Leke chale haey ye sitaam gar mujhe
Alvida-ye- bhayi teri yaad may

5
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
4. Yaad teri ayengi har gaam par (Alamdar)
Qalb ko tarpayengi har gaam par (Alamdar)
Tuj se juda hoke ye teri behan
Kehte huwe jayengi har gaam par

6
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
5. Dard se lachar behan kya kare (Alamdar)
Mere Alamdar Behan kya kare (Alamdar)
Koi Nahi aaj mera dashte mai
Gham me giraftar behan kya kare

7
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
6. Dil pe har ek zakhmo ko sehte Huwe (Alamdar)
Shaam talak jayengi rote huwe (Alamdar)
Teri judaai me mere ba wafa
Aaj sare dasht ye kehte huwe

8
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
7. Baad tere dasht mai chadar chini (Alamdar)
Nawha khuna mujpe huwi bekasi (Alamdar)
Tere bina kaise bhala jayengi
Shaam ke darbar mai binte Ali

9
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
8. Loot pari aisi ke sab loot gaya (Alamdar)
Gar tere jane ke sabab loot gaya (Alamdar)
Wo jo bhara gar tha tere samne
Aake zara dekh wo ab loot gaya

10
Jati hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)
Qaidi hay Zainab (haey Alamdar)

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script body in [alamdar-alamdar-haye-alamdar.md](src/data/lyrics/alamdar-alamdar-haye-alamdar.md) and retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions align verse by verse across the opening and all ten numbered stanzas. Updated the direction to right-to-left, added the Roman title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

The Roman readings “Zainul Iba” and “resuma” were ambiguous. I rendered them as زین العبا and رسُماں.
